question: Will Singapore drop below 5th place in the global AQI city rankings by Oct 8, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Singapore's rank on the IQAir live global major city AQI ranking falls to position 6 or lower (i.e., below 5th place) at any point strictly after 2026-10-05T17:23:37.317Z and at or before 2026-10-08T16:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if Singapore's rank on the IQAir live global major city AQI ranking remains at position 5 or higher (i.e., 5th place or better) throughout the entire window from strictly after 2026-10-05T17:23:37.317Z to 2026-10-08T16:00:00.000Z, never dropping below 5th place.

Clarifications:
- "Global AQI city rankings" refers to the IQAir live most-polluted global major city ranking, ordered by US AQI score descending (rank 1 = most polluted). "Dropping below 5th place" means Singapore's rank number becomes 6 or greater at any observed snapshot within the window. Rankings are real-time and fluctuate hourly; a single confirmed snapshot showing Singapore at rank 6 or lower within the window satisfies the "Yes" condition.
